description: $0.005 via x402: the full header of any block — timestamp and age, transaction count, gas used vs limit with a utilization ratio and congested flag, base fee in gwei, miner and parent hash. /chain/block-number says WHERE the chain is; this says WHEN that block happened and how contested it was. Accepts a height or latest/finalized/safe. Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Gnosis.

number.description: Block height (decimal or 0x hex) or latest|finalized|safe|earliest (default latest)

x_payment.description: signed x402 payment payload (the X-PAYMENT header value) for the terms the first call returns; omit it to get the price and terms

name: chain_block_header
